umbrella_agency.quote: "Licensing agency" means the Indiana professional licensing agency established under IC 25-1-5-3 .

age_minimum.quote: The individual applicant for a license as a plumbing contractor or a journeyman plumber shall be at least eighteen (18) years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant must make a statement that the applicant has not been convicted of: (1) an act that would constitute a ground for disciplinary sanction under IC 25-1-11 ; or (2) a felony that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently.

required.quote: individual applicants for a license as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber must pass an examination

experience_source.quote: individual applicants for a license as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber must pass an examination

exams.name: Plumbing Contractor / Journeyman Plumber Examination
exams.notes: Exam prepared and administered by the commission or its designee; subject matter and passing grade established prior to examination date.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Indiana Plumbing Commission or its designee)
exams.quote: individual applicants for a license as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber must pass an examination. The contents of the examination must, for each license category, test the current level of skills required of persons to be licensed in that category.

interval_years.quote: every license or certificate of registration issued under this chapter expires on a date established by the licensing agency under IC 25-1-6-4 and shall be renewed biennially thereafter upon payment of the required renewal fees.

available.quote: Upon the payment of the required fee, an applicant who is a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber licensed or registered in another state, territory, country, or province, shall without examination, be granted a license as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber by the Indiana Plumbing Commission

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed/registered in another state, territory, country, or province in the same category; requirements of that jurisdiction must have been substantially equal to Indiana's at time of applicant's last registration/licensing; and the other jurisdiction must accord the same privilege to Indiana licensees. Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
requirements.quote: The requirements for the licensing or registration of plumbing contractors or journeyman plumbers in such other state, territory, country, or province, were, at the date of the applicant's last registration or licensing, substantially equal to the requirements in force in this state

exists.quote: The Indiana plumbing commission is hereby created. The commission shall have general charge of the administration and enforcement of this chapter.

regulatory_model.quote: A person who acts or advertises as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber without first obtaining a license from the commission or who continues to act as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber after the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or otherwise restricted under IC 25-1-11 commits a Class A misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: "License" means a certificate issued by the commission established by this chapter which confers upon the holder the privilege to act as a plumbing contractor or a journeyman plumber as defined in this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: A person who acts or advertises as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber without first obtaining a license from the commission ... commits a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting or advertising as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who acts or advertises as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber without first obtaining a license from the commission ... commits a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to act as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber after the license has been suspended, revoked, or otherwise restricted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: who continues to act as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber after the person's license has been suspended, revoked, or otherwise restricted under IC 25-1-11 commits a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to renew a license and continuing to act as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber after the license has expired.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who fails to renew the person's license and continues to act as a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber after the license has expired commits a Class B misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making untrue statements in an application for a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: if it finds the statements to be untrue, may refuse to examine or license the applicant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to register with a political subdivision as required may constitute a basis for suspension or revocation of a plumbing contractor's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to register as required by a political subdivision, upon certification of said failure to the commission, at the discretion of the commission may constitute a basis for suspension of any plumbing contractor's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to repay amounts paid from the plumbers recovery fund results in license suspension and ineligibility for re-licensing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the plumbing commission shall suspend the judgment debtor's license. The licensee is not eligible to be licensed again as either a plumbing contractor or journeyman plumber until the licensee has repaid in full the amount paid from the plumbers recovery fund

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to include the plumbing contractor's name or associated business name on written/printed advertising and vehicles.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for a plumbing contractor to fail to include one (1) of the following names on written or printed advertising for plumbing services and on vehicles that are used to provide plumbing services

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means the practice of and the materials and fixtures used in the installation, maintenance, extension, and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances, and appurtenances in connection with any of the following: (A) Sanitary drainage or storm drainage facilities, the venting system, and the public or private water supply systems, within or adjacent to any building or structure. (B) The practice and materials used in the installation, maintenance, extension, or alteration of the stormwater, liquid waste, or sewerage, and water supply systems of any premises to the private property line or to their connection with any point of public disposal or other acceptable terminal.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means the practice of and the materials and fixtures used in the installation, maintenance, extension, and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances, and appurtenances in connection with any of the following

methods_authorized.quote: installation, maintenance, extension, and alteration of all piping, fixtures, appliances, and appurtenances

license_tiers.quote: "License" means a certificate issued by the commission established by this chapter which confers upon the holder the privilege to act as a plumbing contractor or a journeyman plumber ... "Registration" means the granting of a certificate by the commission that authorizes an individual to act as an apprentice plumber.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice plumber must work under the direct and immediate personal supervision of a licensed plumbing contractor or a licensed journeyman plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Apprentice plumber" means an individual who: (A) is learning the plumbing trade; and (B) is under the direction and immediate supervision of a licensed plumbing contractor or a licensed journeyman plumber.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: The term does not include ... the installation of automatic sprinklers, the overhead or underground water supplies or standpipes when connected to an automatic sprinkler system or to their related devices or appurtenances connecting thereto

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: A corporation may not be licensed as a plumbing contractor unless one (1) of the officers or employees of the corporation holds a valid license as a plumbing contractor issued by the commission.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: The owner occupant of a dwelling of eight (8) or less residential units when the owner occupant is installing, altering, or repairing the plumbing system of the residential units.
